title: ObjectPage
description: Fiori object page floorplan layout: DynamicPage with object header (avatar, facets), sticky navigation bar with anchor (scroll spy) or tabs mode, sections and subsections on cards.

usage.summary: Compose one object’s categorized details with a dynamic header and anchor or tab navigation.
useWhen: Read or edit one object’s details while moving between its categorized sections.
Keep object identity, essential attributes and actions above related forms, item lists and notes.
Use mode="anchor" for a continuous page or mode="tabs" to show one section at a time.

avoidWhen.when: Show only one section without editable header content or section navigation.
Start from a complete display/edit page with sample fields, items, notes and Save/Cancel handling.
Find records with filters or keep a list beside its selected detail.
Guide unfamiliar object creation through 3–8 validated steps and a review screen.
Add noncritical contextual information beside existing object content instead of making it an object section.
